content.text:
Staff members no longer have a limit on items on loan. Adult (30) and junior (10) limits are unchanged. All 61 tests pass.

- **The change:** in `lib/config/defaults.js:10`, the staff entry in `MAX_ITEMS_ON_LOAN` went from `50` to `Infinity`. `canBorrow` in `lib/members/eligibility.js` compares with `>=`, so a staff member can never hit `loan-limit`. I didn't touch the other checks (blocked, expired card, fees owed), so those still apply to staff.
- **Tests:** in `test/eligibility.test.js` I added one for a staff member with 100 open loans, who can still borrow. I also added one for an adult at 30 loans, who is refused. The adult test is there because nothing covered that limit before.
